title: Sustainable enhancement of conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) production in lactic acid bacteria cocultures via ethanol permeabilization
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00425J, Paper

Lan Cheng, Miao Wang, Yingying Wang, Yumeng Chang, Yan Ding, Shuhong Ye
Co-culture with ethanol synergistically enhances CLA production. Ethanol increases membrane permeability, facilitating LA cellular uptake and its isomerization to CLA by LAI.
